description: This file defines a Flutter widget class 'DashboardScreen' and its related UI components for a mobile app dashboard, including header, featured cards, quick actions, curated carousel, and bottom navigation.

classes.name: DashboardScreen
classes.description: Main StatefulWidget representing the dashboard screen with a scaffold containing a bottom navigation bar and a scrollable body with various sections.

classes.name: _DashboardScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the selected tab index and building the dashboard UI.

classes.name: _Header
classes.description: Stateless widget for displaying welcome text and action icons at the top of the dashboard.

classes.name: _TopIconButton
classes.description: Reusable widget for a circular icon button used in the header.

classes.name: _FeaturedCard
classes.description: Widget displaying a promotional featured section with gradient background, title, description, and CTA button.

classes.name: _PillButton
classes.description: Custom widget for rounded CTA buttons.

classes.name: _SectionTitle
classes.description: Widget for section headers like 'Feature' and 'Curated for you'.

classes.name: _QuickActionsRow
classes.description: Row widget containing multiple quick action tiles.

classes.name: _QuickActionTile
classes.description: Widget for individual quick action icons with labels.

classes.name: _CuratedCarousel
classes.description: Horizontal list of curated content cards.

classes.name: _CuratedCard
classes.description: Individual card in curated carousel, with gradient background and add button.

classes.name: _BottomNavBar
classes.description: Custom widget for the bottom navigation bar with fixed items and styling.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for DashboardScreen.
